comments.author: @Teuchter-ahoy
comments.text: I’m from the Scottish highlands and this was released shortly after my dad died suddenly.  I’d also lost two friends in the months following dad….one from a heart attack and one from falling off a mountain while ice claiming.  I was really low for a long time and as a mum of 3 young kids and having a husband who worked away a lot, I was pretty broken.  Nothing was funny, getting up in the morning took everything.  I didn’t go out and I just lost my way.  Anyway, I watched the first episode and was properly laughing for what felt like the first time in forever.  I went on to watch all the seasons and loved every episode.  Thank you Danny McBride, Adam McKay and Will Ferrell - you made a big difference in turning my broken head around.
